```bash
ffmpeg -i radio-lines.mp4 -vf "drawtext=text='@flightschool':fontcolor=white@0.75:fontsize=h/30:x=w-tw-20:y=h-th-20:shadowcolor=black@0.5:shadowx=1:shadowy=1" -c:a copy radio-lines-watermarked.mp4
```

This places semi-transparent white text in the bottom-right corner and preserves the original audio.
